title: Issue #20 - Visual quality, browser harness, bot accuracy, and autonomous ramble execution

source_statements.source_statement: Make the clean-slate release ready for the next owner ramble by hardening visual quality, browser QA sessions, helper/bot accuracy, and autonomous ramble execution.
Do not create a second intake protocol, task manager, agent fleet, memory system, or active-run pointer; reuse and harden the existing canonical systems.
After Issue #18 reaches a terminal read-only verdict, create one parent execution run for Issue #20 and keep child lanes from rewriting the active-run pointer.
Audit and fix global visual quality, measurable design invariants, and permanent visual watchdogs across public, Operations, provider, parent, student, classroom, One Time, and support surfaces.
Build a safe local persistent authenticated agent-browser harness with named profiles, secure storage, lifecycle commands, role smokes, and ChatGPT Agent distinction.
Implement canonical destination resolution, intent evaluation matrices, and agent-mode role QA so helpers/bots return correct scoped links and registered actions.
Implement or verify durable typed agent result drop-off, UI activity visibility, and idempotent GitHub issue/comment ingestion with status posted back to GitHub.
Audit and harden the existing agent fleet, permission tiers, Windows startup, parent-run coordination manifest, and end-to-end background proof.
Reconcile visible queue records into active, decision, external waiting, completed, duplicate, superseded, or internal-evidence classifications with clear owner lanes and audit-safe cleanup.

Create one owner walkthrough page and repo artifact covering live SHA, agent fleet, active goal/lanes, browser profiles, ChatGPT Agent, role links, bot QA, GitHub bridge, Decisions, stop/restart, and next ramble submission.

After all unblocked requirements pass, run focused/full tests, watchdogs, secret/JSON audits, integration, PR/merge, deploy, Railway doctor, live smokes, cleanup, and final response with the required 27 sections and overall state.
